reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter indoor-air and air purifier CADR/filter-cost guide
method: Reviewed the draft against 9 sources on 2026-11-10. AirKorea (미세먼지 종합포털) forecast grades: PM-2.5 좋음 0~15, 보통 16~35, 나쁨 36~75, 매우나쁨 76+ ㎍/㎥; 경보 thresholds. 대기환경기준 (환경정책기본법 시행령, 2018-03-27 시행): PM-2.5 24h 35 ㎍/㎥ / annual 15 ㎍/㎥, 나쁨 시작점 36. 환경부 press releases via AirKorea: 계절관리제 12.1~3.31 since 2019; 2015.12-2024.3 monthly PM-2.5 means 24.0/26.1/26.0/26.8 ㎍/㎥ with 나쁨 days 6/7/7/8; 제6차 seasons 2024-12-01~2025-03-31. KACA (한국공기청정협회) CA mark page and collective standard PDF SPS-KACA002-132 / KACA-CA-2024-08: CADR display value >=90%, ozone <0.03 ppm, applied-area formula A = 7.7 x P (㎡, ㎥/min) with 2.4 m ceiling, 10-minute 50% reduction and 1 air change per hour. KCA (한국소비자원) 2022-10-25 briefing: 8 products, standard area 51.5-85.2 ㎡, prices 239,000-1,427,590 won (6x), filter 54,200-120,000 won/year with 6-14 month cycles, electricity 14,000-26,000 won/year at 7.2 h/day and 160 won/kWh (193-305 won/㎡), noise 46-53 dB(A) all under 55, auto mode 300->80 ㎍/㎥ within 9 min for 6 products, deodorisation 87%+. WHO 2021 guideline 15 ㎍/㎥ 24h / 5 ㎍/㎥ annual via Herald Business. Coupang 2026-11-10 판매량순 verification: Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact AC-M18-SC 48㎡ 116,820 won (158,000 list, 26% off), 633 reviews, 24V/27W, efficiency grade 3, released 2023.04; Samsung Blue Sky 3100 AP70F03102RTD 33.1㎡ 178,600 won (319,000, 44% off) 1,738 reviews; Winix Tower Prime APRM833-JWK 85.8㎡ 235,160 won (519,000, 54% off) 1,372 reviews — the same model code appears in the 2022 KCA test. Calculations (A/7.7 -> required CADR; 5-year filter and electricity totals of 271,000/600,000 and 70,000/130,000, combined 341,000-730,000, ratio 2.3-5.1x, first-year filter 46% of the 116,820 body, 5-year total 387,820) are reproduced in the research file with inputs and are arithmetic on the cited values. Kakao Gift curator links reused from live, already-issued links (4wmjoO73 단미 듀얼 손난로, bFGXVyDC 오설록 티 컬렉션) because the curator dashboard still stops at a DKAPTCHA map challenge; both returned HTTP 200 with matching og:title on 2026-11-10, and the anchors no longer print a price the page does not show.
